exact_delta:
--- reviewed-predecessor
+++ peaso/checks/k8s_ports_workloads.py
@@ -208,14 +208,14 @@
                             raise Unavailable("invalid image pull policy")
                         # Kubernetes defaults untagged/latest images to Always;
                         # pinned tags/digests default to IfNotPresent.
-                        failed = policy != "Always" if policy is not None else tagged
+                        failed = (policy != "Always" if predicate == "always_pull" or policy is not None else tagged)
                         # A SHA256 digest is content-addressed: IfNotPresent can only run the
                         # pinned bytes, so it satisfies the intent of an Always pull for both
                         # variants. Never still trusts whatever the node cached under that name.
                         immutable = bool(re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9./:_-]*@sha256:[0-9a-fA-F]{64}", image))
                         if "@" in image and not immutable:
                             raise Unavailable("unrecognized or malformed content digest reference")
-                        if immutable and policy in (None, "IfNotPresent", "Always"):
+                        if predicate == "content_digest_or_always_pull" and immutable and policy in (None, "IfNotPresent", "Always"):
                             failed = False
             else:
                 raise ValueError("unreviewed workload predicate")
decision: The nine original Always-policy IDs enforce literal configured Always. Nine existing independent immutable-image criteria retain valid SHA256+IfNotPresent and documented default behavior. This removes an unsafe duplicate PASS against the literal policy source while preserving the separate useful security criterion.
source_mappings: Original IDs/framework associations stay with their literal source; no numbered edges added or moved. Original CASES and prior native red/green receipts unchanged.

mutable_legacy_expectations.scope: 36 prose expectations use source-bound exact overlays;9 kubelet positives use Webhook current-only copies instead of unsupported RBAC;2 empty probes remain UNKNOWN plus valid native action PASS;1 image-policy test distinguishes literal source from immutable-image policy. Original CASES/row base hashes unchanged.
